blocks.text: Take one, two, or maybe 42! Share the creativity for any occasion with this bulk 42-pack of Play-Doh small cans. Hand out some non candy treats for birthday parties, party favors for kids, valentines, trick or treat toys, prize box toys for kids classroom, or kids activities. With 1-ounce cans of assorted colors like teal, bright red, yellow, green, and more, there's plenty of squishy fun for kids 2 years and up to shape and share. It's the original Play-Doh modeling compound quality we all know and love in a convenient shipper box that's easy to open and even easier to pass the Play-Doh fun around! Play-Doh sets make great gifts for 2 year old girls and boys and up. Add these preschool toys to your collection. Hasbro, Play-Doh, and all related properties are trademarks of Hasbro.
